A swap multiplies the determinant by $-1$, row replacements don't change it, and scaling a row by $\frac12$ multiplies it by $\frac12$. So $\det B=(-1)(\tfrac12)\det A$. $B$ is triangular with $\det B=1\cdot1\cdot x=x$:
\[\boxed{\det A=-2x}.\]
